solver_notes: Native C11/pthreads regression model executed on physical aarch64 Cortex-A72; this is not a claimed upstream CPython or Linux patch (the supplied metadata mixes torvalds/linux with a CPython target). The deterministic legacy negative control retires/frees the model tstate without head_mutex after a daemon saver has obtained its pointer, then observes an atomic acquire from old_refs=0 after retirement. The fixed path holds head_mutex across interpreter-membership validation and atomic daemon-ref acquisition, drops the list reference after unlocked retirement, and deallocates only after the atomic refcount reaches zero. Real stress executes 2,000 allocated tstates with concurrent saver/deleter threads, 2,000 verified frees, and both acquire/reject orderings. The literal declared function identifiers contain hyphens and are not legal Python identifiers; compatibility test paths are provided and legal underscore identifiers are used. ASan initialization failed in the Pi runtime at sanitizer_allocator_primary64.h (environment limitation, disclosed); UBSan executed the same 2,000-iteration stress with no finding. No claim of upstream CPython validation is made.
